For example, travel permits, overnight permits, shopping permits, late-night snack permits... Annoying bureaucratic stuff like that.
Sure! Mind giving me a quote for all of them?
Umm... What are these bizarre permits?
Do you really need a permit to go shopping?
About that...

sequence: Essex explained the hidden rules regarding permits here in Astrarium.

scripts.say: So we've been influenced by that all along... I never even noticed.
That's an awesome topic for a video! I knew I was right coming to this city!
For all of you... how's this price sound?
I'll add in the on-call service as a bonus.
Only via online contact, of course.
The octopus waves a tentacle to reveal a nine-digit figure this time.
Yep! That's fine.
Richard stuns us all again.
Uh...
Normally, people complain about the price by now...
Even the person who gave the quote is left dumbfounded.
It's an emergency; every second counts! Fast-track this for us, please!
For once, I'm kind of feeling motivated.
Alright. You're my top priority now... Leave the rest to me!
By the time Collett finished her work, it was already late at night.
Richard and I decided to spend another night in Essex's safehouse.
Before we parted ways, Richard gave a few homework assignments to Vicksburg.
Hmm... That ought to do it for now. Do your best, newbie~

sequence: Thus, another night passed without incident.

scripts.say: The next day, Richard and I took the first railcar back to our hotel in the upper city.
After receiving her new identity and address to her safehouse, the cowardly flame finally told us what she knew about the culprit.
On a dark and stormy night, I was passing the time watching the security cameras...
Deep in the hallway, I spotted a terrifying figure.
A pitch-black body, bright-red eyes... and a pair of huge wings!
She was like a tornado... Tearing through the hallway, into your room, and right out the window!
I saw it... She was heading toward the metropolis!
But I can't get that surveillance footage back... and that's all I know!
Professor, do you think we can really trust her?
We've given her a fake identity and safe place to hide, so I don't see any reason for her to lie.
Yeah! Yeah! S-so... can I leave now?
I've told you everything, and I don't wanna be here anymore!
With our approval, the yellow flame darts away in no time.
A black body, red eyes, and big wings... It sounds like a vampire!
A vampire, huh? With so many anomalies in this city, it doesn't sound all that farfetched.
Alright, Professor Detective! The thief flew off toward the metropolis, so let's give chase!
Hmm. Our good friend Miss Detective is off investigating a different case, and most of the fan club is busy helping the newbie...
I know! Let's ask Miss Vlogger to help us!

sequence: Between the upper and lower cities

scripts.say: Good morning, afternoon, and evening to everyone~
I'm Bennington, up-and-coming vlogger! Today, we're going on an exhaustive tour of Astrarium's metropolis area!
If you've been keeping up, you'll know that this city is called the city of dreams. But it has a hidden side full of strange anomalies and dark secrets!
The metropolis, heart of Astrarium, is the lap of luxury! Only VIP guests with special invitations get to get in...
But of course, that won't stop me! Heheh, check this out!
I've got my own invitation just for us♪
Now, what kind of place is the real metropolis?
Come and explore with me! Don't blink, or you might miss something amazing!
We could see Bennington hard at work long before we were close.
She's a real professional, huh? No matter where she goes, she's filming. No wonder she's a viral vlogger!
Viral...? Didn't she call herself a rookie, though?
Heheh~ You've got a lot to learn, Professor. That's just branding!
Calling yourself a rookie shows that you haven't forgotten your roots~
Does that make you a newbie idol, too?
Aww, you don't have to compare us... But I am a newbie assistant detective, after all!
And now... Ah, Professor Detective, I'm starving~ I sure do wanna try that crepe...
Richard looks at me pitifully, as if I've denied her the tastiest food in all the world, and gazes at my crepe.
She's already holding half of her own crepe. If I hadn't seen her walking around devouring all of the food in sight, I might feel bad for her.
You're such a meanie... Then I'll just have to help myself. Chomp!
Wha?!
Chomp... Mm! It's delicious!
Thanks, Professor! I love you so much!
Sure~ You should try getting a taste of me along with it!
Ahem... Good morniiing!
The weather is great today. Perfect for filming!
Good morning, Miss Vlogger! Are you still filming now?
I put it on hold for now. A few solo shots along the way ought to finish it... Oh! Don't worry, I wasn't filming you two!
We know! Not that we'd get mad if you did.
Really?! A vlog with the two of you could rocket up to a hundred million views...
I mean it~ Capturing the beautiful moments of life is like your job, isn't it?
You just have to show us before you upload it.
(Hmm?)
I can't express it well, but something seems really odd about Richard right now.
Whatcha thinking about, Professor? You think I'm acting weird, don't you?
For an idol enjoying time away from the public, you're standing out an awful lot.
Hmm... I do want her to film us, but maybe I don't actually want her to publish it...
I knew it!
Heheh~ Don't be mad. You just can't post anything with me and the Professor together – stuff with just you and me are okay.
Oh! Then I'd love to take you up on that! Aw man, it really is the perfect day to vlog!
What was intended to be a serious investigation had become a sightseeing tour, thanks to them.
Naturally, it did not yield any useful results.
In the end, we had to request Collett's on-call service to trace the thief's moves on the night of the crime.
Most of the surveillance footage along her route was deleted... except for one that I managed to recover.
Check this out. See that dark figure up in the sky? She disappeared right above Astral Tower.
Astral Tower is the central landmark of Astrarium, and it's where the CEO's office is located.
Unfortunately, I can't hack that system. I can't forge an entry permit, either.
If the criminal is really hiding in Astral Tower, then you'll have to think of another way.
Whoa... This case is getting deeper and deeper.
Times like this call for a group strategy meeting!
Agreed! Miss Vlogger, can you call the other fan club members? We can meet up at Miss Detective's safehouse.
And have our newbie idol get ready, too!
As her mentor, I'll need to check up on her progress. Heheh~
After dinner, we met up with Vicksburg and her fan club in Essex's safehouse.
If you want a way to get into Astral Tower, I actually have an interesting idea.
Look at this news article. The owner of Astral Tower is organizing a city-wide festival and calling for public program submissions...
If your performance is selected, your entire team gets to perform inside Astral Tower!
This could be a great opportunity to get in there and investigate!
Vicksburg's information seems well worth noting, indeed.
A performance, huh? Well... There's only one act we could put together on such short notice, right?
What act?
Come on, Harrison! An IDOL performance! We've got two idols right here, don't we?!
Wooow, you're so smart!
Hah! Unlike you, I'm a grown-up fan club captain, after all!
They'd definitely pick a duo performance with Vicksburg and Richard, and then, we can waltz right into the tower!
Yeah! And a show like that would be awesome enough to get the whole city fired up!
Huh? A concert with Richard herself?! Aah, I'm suddenly feeling a lot of pressure... I-I'll do my best to keep up!
Is it settled, then?
Hey! Hey, Professor, I have a question!
If the thief is connected to the tower, then is it really a good idea for the victim of the crime to be standing up on stage?
Urk...
Hmm.
You WOULD stand out a lot.
Holding a concert is a good idea, but what if our newbie here was the only one to perform?
M-me? Alone?!
Don't all idols dream of solo concerts?
You heard her, Vicksburg! This is the chance of a lifetime!
And Richard, you'll help her get ready, won't you?
Of course! I've always wanted to try being the mastermind running everything behind the scenes!
Mastermind? I don't know if that's an appropriate comparison at the moment...
Heheh, close enough!
Okay... I'll use my singing to guide all of you into the Astral Tower.
That's the spirit! Now you're thinking like a truly radiant idol.
So now the question is, how do we submit our application?
Take a look at this.
Collett projects a model of something. It seems to be a person, but to me, it only looks like a faint blue flame.
This is the person in charge of program registration.
Convince her, and you can skip the long screening and review process.
Huh. So it's time to play by Astrarium's rules again.
Equivalent exchange... Time to run another errand, then?
Hop to it, Professor Detective!
The next day, we followed the map to locate the office of our target.
*sigh*... This is depressing...
You wanna skip the whole screening process? How depressing can you get...
Just tell us if you can do it or not!
Can I? Sure, but I'm just so depressed...
If that's the only problem, then why don't you tell us what's wrong? Maybe we can help!
People like you keep coming in and adding to my workload... You're not the only ones.
There's too much work to do in this city. *sigh*... So depressing.
Ugh! Quit whining and say what you want, already!
Rodgers... We're the ones asking a favor, remember?
I know that!
Ahem... PLEASE quit whining and say what you want! There.
I wish I could work forever and never clock out...
That's what I want. If you can solve this depressing problem, I'll give you a performance permit.
W-wait, you... WANT to work forever?!
Exactly!
I can't say I don't sympathize.
Come again?!
Wow! You really do have endless passion for your work, Professor.
Hmm... We won't be able to resolve a crazy wish like this one through normal means.
Maybe our dear detective friend might have a lead?
Are you saying... we need to find an anomaly that will grant this wish?
Heheh, suits this city, doesn't it?
On the way back to the safehouse, Richard stopped at a nearby snack shop and splurged yet again.
It was as if she had insatiable curiosity for every unfamiliar brand in the place.
Well... We won't run out of snacks, that's for sure.
Heheh. Feel free to partake!
Upon learning of the blue flame's wish, Essex began rummaging through the pile of notebooks on her desk.
"The case of the salaryman who can't leave work"... I found it!
These notes detail an anomaly that occurred in the upper city six months ago.
It took place at an apartment codenamed Unit X. It was first reported by an employee who escaped by jumping out of a third-story window.
When they finished a day's work and tried to clock out, they would find themselves in a new workday instantly after.
Despite all the work they were subjected to, oddly, they felt no fatigue.
Oh! I think I saw that TV show!
Basically, they split this guy's brain into two parts. One of them is always working whenever it's awake, and the other one is always off work whenever it's awake.
I... see? I'm afraid I don't know that one.
Heheh. I watch a lot of TV!
Anyway, you didn't finish your story. What happened with the apartment?
It was left vacant and was recently put up for auction.
Wait, they just cleared it out and put it up for sale? What about the anomaly investigation?
Per these notes, the final decision was to prevent anybody from working there as a workaround. Nobody can be overworked if nobody can work, after all.
Wow... Flawless logic.
That doesn't actually resolve the problem though, does it?
Agreed. That's why nobody has bought the apartment.
I get it! If we buy it and gift it to that administrator, won't that count as granting her wish?
That sounds dangerous...
It'll be okay as long as we make her aware of the risks.
I'm all for it! Sis, you're too indecisive!
Well, Detective? What do you think?
Usually, I would be against this...
(But those flames probably don't have the same constitution as normal humans...)
It's not as if we can grant her wish through normal means. Let's communicate the risks clearly and leave the decision up to her.
Alriiight! Sold!
We returned to the metropolis and told the blue flame about the apartment. She replied that she'd move the whole office there soon.
With her wish granted, we had successfully secured a performance permit.
Thanks for granting my wish! Since you did the impossible, I'll share some important info with you...
If you want to go into Astral Tower, then a performance permit won't be enough.
I thought it would permit us to perform. Like, that's in the name, right?
*sigh*... It only authorizes the performance itself. Public performances need management and preparation, right? Each of those will require another permit...
What, specifically, do we need?
Costume permit, stage equipment permit, venue usage permit...
Security team permit, advertising permit... Get all five of those, and you're good.
That's way too many!
Is there any way you can handle all five of those for us?
*sigh*... Not possible. It's so depressing... I don't have the authorization to process those...
I also don't know how you can get them. Good luck. I'd better get back to work, or else I'll be really depressed...
The blue flame drifts away, leaving a heavy air in her wake.
So this is the dark side of Astrarium... I'd better capture all of it!
Your thoughts, security specialist?
...Even if I could hack the system, forging five permits is a tall order.
But I think I can figure out who's in charge of each permit.
It'll be a hassle, but if we take it one step at a time... I'm sure I can make it happen.
If that's our only option, then so be it. Let's do our best to make Vicksburg's show a success!
Remember, our real goal is to find Richard's master recording...
Ahem... Of course I remember that! I'd never forget something that important!
Yeah, yeah.
Five whole permits...
Don't look so down, girls!
All things considered, we've made progress! We should celebrate!
Let's go eat good food tonight – my treat~
Of course, I'll set aside some for you, Miss Security Specialist! I look forward to hearing that intel on the five permits~
We returned to Error XIII's home with takeout in hand. As it turned out, Collett had already finished her task.
A robotic cat just like the one at the restaurant accepted the food from us, and a projection of Collett appeared nearby.
I found all five of the permit admins.
But... if you really want to hold a concert, then finding them is nowhere near what it takes.
Urk... Right, we have to arrange the equipment, costumes, and security ourselves!
I totally forgot...
Heh... Don't worry. I have reliable contacts for all of the above, and I'd be happy to introduce you.
You'll have to figure out venue setup and advertising for yourselves, though.
But if you needed somebody to hack all of the upper and lower city billboards to advertise for you, well...
Absolutely not!
Professor, let's work on prioritizing our list of tasks.
I think getting the venue usage permit is our top priority. It's definitely the first thing we need to do.
Next would be costumes and stage equipment. We need to get those ready before we can make promotional materials.
I can help shoot the promo vid!
Thanks for volunteering! I was gonna pick you anyway, though.
Once those are all dealt with, THEN we can worry about security.
I don't know much about that, so... Miss Security Specialist, can we really trust those people you know?
One hundred percent. They're a good deal, to boot.
Then it's fine by me. What do you think, Professor?
Richard's plan for our upcoming operations is perfect.
Fine by me, too. Let's go with your plan.
Heheh, awesome!
What? Having second thoughts now? Let's do it already!
Get 'em, Professor Detective! You're the arm-wrestling champion!
Somehow, I've found myself in a mysterious place, inexplicably engaged in an arm-wrestling match with a security guard.
How did I get myself into this mess? Well...
That's our story. Could you please approve a venue usage permit for our show?
How depressing... Our city of dreams has been overtaken by shadow...
Um... Come again?
There are too many wishes in this city for one person to grant... *sigh*... Depressing.
You must have something you want, right? Out with it!
Find a community where wishes remain unfulfilled, and grant them...
Do that, and you can have a permit...
Like community service?
That doesn't sound too hard. Let's get this over with.
Your wish is... to have an arm-wrestling match with somebody?
Heh. Better hope I don't break your arm off!
I can't believe I lost...
It takes a real master to hide your skills... I have no regrets.
Security Guard Red vanishes into particles of light.
Great job, Professor Detective! Let's head on to the next request!
Are there no kind souls in the world...?
Your kind souls have arrived!
Here you go. We hope this helps~
Finally, a helping hand... Thank you so much.
Beggar Blue vanishes into particles of light.
Neeext!
Wh-who's there! Help me! HEEEELP!
Don't worry! We'll untie you right now!
Finally, I'm saved... Thank goodness for you.
Aristocrat Yellow vanishes into particles of light.
Let's go see who needs our help next!
Somebody, heeelp. My kitty got on the roof and won't come down...
You can ride Error XIII up to the roof.
Wow, thank you! Now I can be happy...
Juvenile Black vanishes into particles of light.
How long are we going to have to keep doing this?
I fear we won't be done until all of the wishes in this community are granted.
Let's proceed.
I'm hurt... Can anybody please help me clean my chimney?
*staaare*...
I sure hope this is the last one.
It's as clean as a whistle... Thank you.
Tailor Green vanishes into particles of light. Suddenly, Administrator Grey appears.
You're kind-hearted people. The test is over.
Here's your reward: one venue usage permit.
With that, Administrator Grey, too, vanishes into particles of light.
Great work, everybody~ That's one more permit in the bag!
It's finally over...
Well, this was certainly one anomaly worth recording.
I'd better write up a new entry.
Okay, let's work on our next plan of action!
After dinner, we gathered as usual in Essex's safehouse.
Next, we'll need to handle the costume permit and stage equipment permit.
These will involve working with vendors AND our newbie idol's preferences.
I suggest we split up into two teams!
One can handle negotiating with those annoying administrators, while the other will join Vicksburg in contacting vendors!
Miss Security Specialist, could you introduce us to the people in charge and the vendors?
Both of the administrators are in the metropolis, and I'm sure you know how to deal with them well enough by now.
The first vendor would be costume designer Pamiat' Merkuria. PM Plaza in the upper city is named after her.
She's known for wheeling and dealing, so be careful you aren't taken advantage of in negotiations.
As for the stage equipment, the vendor you want runs an old shop called Shining☆Forever in the lower city.
Her name is Saratoga, and you might recognize her as a former superstar idol.
Of course!
Huh? You mean THE Saratoga?!
I had no idea she opened a shop in Astrarium after her retirement... and in the lower city, at that!
Here's how we'll divide the labor!
Miss Detective, Professor Detective, and I will find the permit administrators and take their requests. Vicksburg and her fan club will contact the vendors!
Keep in touch, okay? Let's meet up at the safehouse again tonight!
Roger that!
I'm sorry. I have plans to investigate an anomaly tomorrow.
No problem~ Focus on your work! The Professor and I can handle this on our own.
Following yesterday's division of labor, Richard and I visited the administrator responsible for stage equipment permits.
*sob*... I'm so sad...
Hi there!
So very sad...
Just get to it, please.
*sob*... The stage equipment permit, right...
*sob*... I want to hear music that moves my heart...
If you can play moving music for me, then the permit is yours...
Music that moves the heart, huh? Like an emotional song?
*sob*... If you want to put on a show, then you must have a band... I want to hear your music live!
Which means...
Professor, let's start a band together!
WHAT?!
After that, we headed to the office of the costume permit administrator, but they were away.
Maybe one of the city's rules is that you can only take on one mission at a time...?
If so, then there's nothing else we can do.
About that band thing...
Do it, Professor! We took on the request together, after all!
Don't worry – I'll teach you everything you need to know. It'll be fun~
When we returned to the safehouse, Vicksburg's group happened to arrive at the same time.
Just as Richard and I had only met one administrator, they had also only met with one vendor.
It must be some kind of city rule...
Tch! The city's trying really hard to stop our show. What a nuisance!
Don't panic, everybody. We just have to take things one step at a time! Our negotiations with Saratoga went really well, remember?
So the rental contract for the stage equipment is ready?
That's right. She really lives up to her reputation – there was a whole warehouse full of instruments and equipment!
Then all that's left is the matter of our band.
(I still can't believe we're doing this...)
Have any of you played instruments before?
Of course! As the fan club captain, that's only natural!
Rodgers has been practicing really hard in secret so she can play with Bennington someday~
It was not in secret! I-I mean... N-no, I was not practicing!
Ack... That's not right. Umm... I mean I wasn't practicing that hard!
Hahaha... I've practiced with them a little, but it was mostly just for vlogs.
Well, it's time to announce our lineup!
Newbie on vocals, vlogger on drums, fan club captain on bass, vice-captain on guitar, and me and the Professor together on keyboard~
Wanna join us, Miss Security Specialist? We could use a synthesizer.
Sounds like a pain. Pass.
Okay, then can I also–
SHE can refuse, but you don't get to!
We'll be practicing at Sara's shop!
Practice starts tomorrow. Deal? Deal!
Welcome to Shining☆Forever!
scripts.actorName: Cup Ramen Ambassador? [Morning Sun Over Azure Skies]

scripts.say: Richard told me everything. You can use any of the instruments and equipment here as you please!
scripts.actorName: Cup Ramen Ambassador? [Morning Sun Over Azure Skies]

scripts.say: I'll be cheering you on!
scripts.actorName: Cup Ramen Ambassador? [Morning Sun Over Azure Skies]

scripts.say: As soon as we step through the door, the owner greets us enthusiastically.
(The retired idol, Saratoga...)
Some of the fog in my mind seems to clear, but I can't remember any further information.
Thanks, Sara!
Let's go see the studio in the basement, everyone!
Wow... If not for the whole master recording theft, you'd probably be able to get us into the tower just from your fame alone, huh?
Maybe! I think it could work.
When this is all resolved, I'll take you all to the tower so we can have some fun!
Stay just like that, Professor. I'll adjust your posture for you.
Also, the bass needs to be tuned a little better. Give it here and I'll take care of it for you.
Professor, put your hand here and match my moves~
The drum was off-tempo there. Let's try again!
Great job, Professor. Keep it up!
Also...
Sorry. I know, that was my mistake.
Let's run it back!
You did great! See? You really got the hang of it.
And Vicksburg, your singing was spot-on – heck, everybody's performance was!
Ten more practice runs, and we'll call it a day.
Rehearsal finally came to an end at dusk.
Phew! I feel a lot better after banging those drums all day!
I'm... so tired...
Suddenly, the idea of working backstage doesn't sound so bad...
Good work, everyone. And Rodgers, you did wonderfully.
Thank you for your wonderful instruction today, Richard!
Don't mention it♪
You all worked hard. The last run-through felt really good!
And good work to you, too, Professor.
I mean... I was just letting you guide me the whole time. You must be the most tired out of all of us.
I'm just fine. I had fun!
Didn't you, Professor?
*sniffle*... *sob*...
The next day, we invited Administrator Black to Shining☆Forever to have her review our results.
What beautiful music... *sob*... It feels like my soul is purer now.
*sniffle*... I'm so moved...
You pass! Here's your stage equipment permit! Take it!
After giving us the permit, Administrator Black left, crying all the while.
Uh... I know we played pretty well, but that felt like a bit of an overreaction.
Seeing the way she cried, I'd be surprised if ANY song didn't drive her to tears.
Huh?! Then were we even good?!
You were! I certainly approve.
Phew... That's a relief. Heheh, let's get the whole town pumped with our music!
Aren't you just going to use a backing track for the show?
Yes, that would be the plan...
Why?!
Don't forget that our ultimate goal here is to help Richard solve the mystery of the stolen recording.
Ooooh, right!
It feels like we've had this exchange twice now...
I didn't forget twice!
I mean... No, I totally remembered both times! Not once have I forgotten!
Sorry! This is kind of a special case.
If we ever get the chance, I'd love to perform on stage with all of you!
Really?! You promise?!
Yep, I promise~
Anyway, with that mission completed, the next one should be available now.
Shall we split up again?
Next is the costume permit, right?
That means we get to go pick an outfit at the store, right? Let's knock it out, easy-peasy!
Let's go, Professor.
What? You want a costume permit?!

options.content: We know that. What do you want?
(Poke her to see if that skips this dialogue.)

scripts.say: I don't give out permits to just anybody, you know!
Heh. And what makes you think I'd give out missions to just anybody?
Hey! Quit touching me!
Our CEO is very particular about our show costumes!
As the administrator, it's my job to maintain strict quality control!
Whoa... This one's kind of a pain.
It's called professionalism! Anyway, if you want a permit, then you'd better pick a costume that satisfies ME!
Weren't we supposed to be satisfying the CEO...?
The CEO would never be satisfied by a costume that doesn't satisfy me!
So... You just need to see the outfit? The person wearing it doesn't have to be present, as long as you have a photo of the right one?
Exactly! But if you try to pull any tricks, you're NEVER getting that permit!
Okay, okay.
I'm sure our idol has good taste!
She should be at the shop right now, so I'll just have her send a photo over.
Shortly before...
Vicksburg Fan Club, welcome to PM Plaza!
Have a look around! Pick out whatever you like – costumes, pen lights, stage props, you name it.
Thank you for your help, Pamiat'!
Aww, what's this little kitty robot? Can I hold it?
Go right ahead...
Excuse me, um, Pamiat'? Is it okay if I film a vlog in here?
Oh, you're a vlogger? Of course you can. Make sure you get my good side~
Gladly!
Rodgers, they sell stage props here. Wanna buy a few together?
Heck yeah! This is Vicksburg's first time performing at Astral Tower, so we'd better deck out that stage!
Good luck picking your costume, Vicksburg!
Shortly after, Vicksburg sent back a photo of a stage outfit.
Oooh~ That's really cute!
How about this? Passes with flying colors, am I right?
No! It's too cute! It doesn't fit the lavish atmosphere of a festival! This will never pass!
Huh...?
Huh? This costume won't work?
The administrator in charge of our approval said that it's too cute and not "lavish" enough...
I see... Wanna try putting something else together from this section?
After a while, we receive a second photo from Vicksburg.
This one is great, too... It really highlights the wearer's aura!
Surely you'll like this one!
No! It's too flashy! You'll steal the spotlight from our CEO!
I... disagree?

sequence: After the third round of adjustments...

scripts.say: What about this one? I think it's good enough.
No. The CEO won't be satisfied with that!

sequence: After the tenth round of adjustments...

scripts.say: SURELY the CEO would go crazy over this one!
No, no, no! This one isn't even as good as the last one you showed me!

sequence: After the fifteenth round of adjustments...

scripts.say: Hey... Can we just call it good already, please?
No! This review must be rigorous! You must always strive for perfection!

sequence: After the twentieth round of adjustments...

scripts.say: Aaaargh! We've done this twenty times now!
Do you think we should think about forging the permit instead...?
Or we can just have a "chat" with that administrator! Let's have her explain exactly what's wrong with ANY of these costumes!
Pamiat'... I'm very sorry for the trouble.
No, you're not the ones at fault. It's that admin who's the problem!
This goes way beyond you all!
I picked all of these outfits MYSELF! Directly! And she's still not happy?
That is a condemnation of my boutique – of my taste!
I have no choice but to use my last resort now...
That's enough for today. Come back tomorrow!
Bring them all here!
By then, all will be resolved! Heheheh...
When we went to PM Plaza the next day, Pamiat' was nowhere to be found.
A costume permit and twenty stage costumes sat atop the counter.
One note was also left alongside them.
It's all taken care of! The costumes are all yours, too. Good luck at your show! I'll be cheering you on.
Huh? It was that easy?
Feels a little anticlimactic... Something must have happened to change that administrator's mind last night!
News flash. Check this out.
The cat robot projects a news broadcast into mid-air.
Early this morning, there was a gas explosion in the metropolis, severely damaging an office building.
Ah! Isn't that the building we went to just yesterday?!
There's a gas explosion at night, and then we get the permit for free the next day... I don't think this is a coincidence.
Could it be... Aaah! Everyone, look around us! The shop disappeared!
Huh? PM Plaza is gone?!
The entire plaza has disappeared into thin air, as if it were never there to begin with.
There's no doubt... This has to be a new anomaly!
Aw, man! I wish I had my camera rolling!
That's a shame. We missed out on some primo footage!
It's cool. As long as we're in Astrarium, we'll run into more opportunities before long.
Speaking of, the frequency of anomalies in this city has really gone up lately...
Essex has been busy every day. We hardly ever get to see her unless it's night time.
Great work, everybody.
Putting aside all the crazy stuff that happened, we finally got our hands on a costume permit.
Only the advertising permit and security team permit remain.
Two left... It feels like this is never going to end!
But there's something fun about days full of preparation, isn't there?
Put it this way: two more errands, and we'll be ready!
We'll just have the concert and the big investigation of Astral Tower. I can't wait!
Same here~
Now, I think it's about time for a celebration. We'll invite Miss Detective too, of course!
With the permits for costumes and stage equipment procured, our next step was the advertising permit.
Bennington could handle the promotional videos just fine herself, but we'd need the permit to actually run them.
Professor Detective, let's get to work on our next mission!
You want an advertising permit...?
Advertising permits... Always advertising permits...
Ahem... Have you heard of the cursed business cards?
What's that? Another anomaly?
Lately, strange cards have been appearing in the western industrial district of the lower city.
All of them are labeled with the name of a company that nobody has ever heard of...
This might sound like a joke, but... if you pick up even one of those cards, you wake up locked in an abandoned factory!
Then, you can never leave unless you collect three of the same cards.
Several people have already gone missing. Alone, that's already common in anomalies.
But the problem is that people are getting too scared to look at regular advertising flyers anymore!
This anomaly is having serious effects on the city's advertising industry. It has to be dealt with at once!
Alriiight! Mission accepted – dealing with the cursed business cards!
Professor Detective, go get everyone. We'll meet up outside of the industrial district.
Oh, and call Miss Detective, too!
The industrial district was much larger than I'd anticipated. However, most of the factories were abandoned, leaving little foot traffic.
Hazy fog hung above. Even though it was just past lunch time, it was as dark as twilight.
This place has total anomaly vibes... Recording now!
Hello, hello! Long time no see, viewers. It's your favorite rookie vlogger, Bennington!
Remember not to get me and the Professor!
Don't worry!
Okay, question!
I know we're not supposed to pick up the bad cards, but how are we supposed to know which ones are bad?
Judge based on whether you recognize the company showed on it~
But I don't know any companies...
Oh, my...
Here's an idea: don't touch any cards at all.
Given how well-known this anomaly is, nobody out there is making new cards to give out anyway.
Whoa... That's brilliant! No wonder you're a detective.
Heheh. Let's all split up and find out where these cards are coming from!

options.content: How long is my name going to get, exactly?
Didn't you just say we were splitting up?

scripts.say: Let's go, Brilliant Professor Detective~
Oh, we're just getting started!
Yep! You and I will split off from everybody else♪
We walked alongside the greenery for a while until we spotted a few suspicious cards.
The supersonic passenger plane has made its triumphant return! Just today, the Supernova, a supersonic passenger aircraft developed by the OXS Trade Alliance, completed its maiden flight...
Cards with companies I've never heard of...
There are still plenty more around.
Choose Rotwolf Security Group! Let us provide you and your loved ones with the highest level of security services!
The heated debate over next-generation KAN-SEN rigging continues to rage. The Croweheed Group announced in a press release that the official name for this novel type of armament will be...
Professor!
You just picked up a business card, didn't you?
Damn... I was so focused on reading it that I forgot.
Hahaha... I can't believe YOU would make a mistake!
Richard laughs in an attempt to ease my awkwardness. Then, she casually swipes the card from my hand.
What are you doing? That's dangerous.
Don't you worry~ We're switching to plan B.
I'll let the others know. Everybody will pick up a card, and we'll be able to investigate the factory instead!
Thick fog enveloped us, and before we knew it, we were standing in front of an abandoned factory.
Unbelievable! When we picked up those cards, we really were whisked away to a factory!
Something isn't quite right here...
Supposedly, picking up one of the cards locks you into the factory until you can find three of the same card.
But we're standing OUTSIDE of the gate. If we simply don't go inside, I don't see how we can be locked in it.
Shall we go in, then?
- Of course not! - Absolutely!
Whaaat?! Why do you wanna go in?!
Because it sounds fun! Besides, we took on a mission to resolve the anomaly, remember?
There seems to be a signboard near the gate. It may have some clues for us.
A signboard? I'll go check it out.
Found it!
What does it say?
We're closed for a day off. Come back another time.
Okaaay...?
Do urban anomalies take time off, too?
My last job never did that! This is no fair!
Heeey! Is anybody in there?
Richard swaggers up to the gate and knocks on it firmly.
Three knocks later, the gate comes crashing down.
It causes a chain reaction, leading to the walls and everything within collapsing.
In thirty seconds flat, the abandoned factory has turned to rubble... and vanishes into thin air.
Um?
What the heck just happened?
Phew... It's a good thing I kept the camera rolling! That's going to make for awesome footage!
The way it collapsed was reminiscent of something being struck by a massive force.
And just like that, it's resolved.
What a superstar... Bon Homme Richard's strength is world-class, too!
Uh, all I really did was knock on the door a little.
A-anyway, I don't know why that fixed it, but it looks like our problem is solved~
Let's go report a job well done and get that advertising permit!
After we'd obtained the advertising permit, Bennington enthusiastically led Vicksburg and her fan club off to begin filming.
With that, Richard and I had once again come to the metropolis to undertake a new request.
Y-you two want... a s-security team permit?
Tell us the mission already!
I-if the security team makes me feel safe... then I'll give you the permit...
Mission received! I appreciate your expediency, Yellow.
Professor, let's go! We need to meet up with everyone at the place Miss Security Specialist recommended!

sequence: Lower City - Bigger Is Better Machine Laboratory

scripts.say: More is merrier, and bigger is beautiful! Welcome to Bigger Is Better Machine Laboratory!
Soobrazitelny, genius mechanic, at your service!
Hi there, Miss Genius Mechanic. We'd like to hire a team to handle security for a concert.
A concert, huh? I have a few tried-and-tested options I can suggest.
Would you like to arm yourselves, or go with a robotic force?
Arm ourselves... Can you tell us more? What exactly does that entail?
Things like wearable power armor, pilotable large mechs. That kind of stuff.
Though you can't exactly take a large mech into the Astral Tower with you...
Wearable power armor... I bet you'd look cool in that, Professor!
If we were all in power armor, we wouldn't even need to hire a team!
Can I take that as your answer?
Wait a minute! Don't you all have other things you should be doing during the concert?
Standing stage-side in power armor would be, um... a little inconvenient, don't you think?
R-riiight... Ahem. I didn't forget that!
Then will it be robots for you?
Yeah. We'd like the robot army, please.
Take a look at my digital catalogue. There are different units to choose from, and we do offer bundle discounts!
I'll take the most expensive one~
Wow! A big spender, indeed!
Heheh~ Can you prepare an execution plan soon?
Yes, with guaranteed quality and two backup plans – they'll be in your inbox tomorrow morning!
Upon receiving Soobratizelny's proposals, we brought a security robot to the metropolis.
After such thorough preparation, surely our mission was complete.
However, the yellow flame's expectations were higher than expected.
As for your first plan... Hmm, you have too few robots on the outer perimeter. It's too dangerous!
And your second one has too few on the inner perimeter. Oh, how terrifying!
But your third plan has fewer inner-perimeter robots than the first one AND fewer outer-perimeter robots than the second. This is even worse!
I have a feeling that this is going to be as painful as the costume permit process...
Any more gas explosions about to happen, you think?
Hmm... I think I have a good idea!
Hey Yellow, what do you think about drag racing?
R-racing? That's terrifying! Just the thought of it...
But have you ever tried it?
Of course not! I'd never do something so dangerous.
How can you know true safety before you've felt danger?
I suppose... you have a point? Even if it sounds awful...
Wait, I don't get it... Ack, Sis, quit pulling me!
She almost has her convinced! Either help her out or shut up.
Ah... Ahem! Richard is absolutely right!
See? There just so happens to be a race planned on the beltway tomorrow, so let's experience some real danger together!
Are you sure you're not just trying to have fun?
Heheh, why can't it be both?
You can watch from the stands while I kick butt!
The crowd was already roaring even before the event had begun, heralding the start of an incredible event.
This course takes a full loop around Astrarium!
I've been wanting to race here since I arrived, and finally, the time has come!
I hope I'm not asking a stupid question here, but don't you need a car to be in the race?
Already bought one and signed up to join, naturally~
When in the world...
Heheh, there are still so many things you don't know about me, Professor.
So, does anyone else wanna race? Signups are still ongoing!
Cool! If you have a spare car, I'd LOVE to take it for a spin!
Of course I do. Okay, anybody else want in?
I... think I'll pass.
Same...
I'm not much of a driver, but all you have to do is keep your foot on the gas, right?
That's not exactly how racing works...
Really?! I-I mean, of course I knew that! It was just a joke!
Okay, so the newbie, fan club captain, and vice-captain are a no. Yellow, how about you?
*sob*... It's too scary for me to ever do! I can't!
But it's fun! Professor, your answer?
I'll pass. You know you have a problem here, don't you?
Your goal is to let Yellow experience danger, but she doesn't want to join. What's the plan now?
I'll just let her ride with me!
Don't the rules say that the driver has to be the only person in the car?
Yeah, but they don't... Oh. Okay, yeah, I guess I can't.
Whoopsie~ Teehee☆
So we ARE here all because you wanted to race.
Ahem! Actually, I just thought of a solution!
This race has a scenic route.
All of you can get on a sightseeing car with Yellow. That way, she can see the speed and thrill from up close!
I suppose that is an acceptable level of danger.
Sounds like a deal to me!
Miss Security Specialist, use your drone to record my best moments, please!
Roger that. Recording now.
Miss Vlogger, let's go get your registration in! It's time to have some real fun!
YaaaHOOOO! Full speed ahead!
Heheh! Straightaways come down to a car's raw performance, so I'll let you take the lead for now!
Why does a city beltway have this many curves?!
Maybe it was specially designed that way to make it more difficult and fun? Check out these consecutive drifts!
She passed me that easily?! D-damn, she's fast!
It's the final spurt, Miss Vlogger~
Oh... She's already out of sight.
Guess it's an easy win for me!

sequence: Richard put the pedal to the metal.

scripts.say: Thus, the lively race came to an end.
Richard had fallen behind for a moment, owing to her car's lower top speed.
However, her perfect driving allowed her to command a powerful lead after a series of curves.
While Bennington held the lead for a while, her mistakes on those same curves disrupted her rhythm, ultimately causing her to finish in ninth place.
Aaargh, I lost!
Richard, you're even better than the pros...
Heheh~ It's just a hobby.
Professor, how's Yellow doing? Did she get enough danger for one day?
Well..
Asdfjkl...
She fainted halfway through the race.
Heeey, wake up!
Urgh... Where am I... Aaaah, you're gonna crash! No more... We're gonna diiie!
Hey, hey, you're safe! The race ended a while ago.
Did you get to feel some danger for once?
O-o-of course I did! *sob*... It was so scary, I thought I'd die!
But you didn't.
Nothing bad happened at all during the race. Do you feel that wave of relief?
So this is... relief? This is how safety feels... I DO feel it.
But can your security team...
The security team is already doing a great job. After all, we'll be using the same team that this very race used~
Huh? Really?!
I see... No wonder I recognized all of those patrol robots.
Didn't we just decide to enter the race yesterday?
I had it all arranged overnight! The power of money can solve many problems.
It was the same security team... In that case, you pass!
Thus, we had secured the final permit we needed.
We now had the performance permit, stage equipment permit, costume permit, advertising permit, AND security team permit.
Nothing else could stand between us and the concert.
Oh, thank goodness...
What a hassle that all was. I'm just glad it's over!
Now, we just have to officially submit our concert application and wait for the Astral Tower's approval.
And... perform our final rehearsal, of course!
We'll need to work out a specific plan of action, as well.
All of that can wait until tomorrow.
Let's spend the rest of the day partying hard!
Which restaurant should we go to? Any requests?
If you wanna celebrate, then what if we went to the safehouse instead?
You've been spending a lot of money for us lately... Why not let me and Rodgers cook for you instead?
That's right! Leave all the cooking to me! Uh... Me and Sis, I mean!
Ooh! Then the Professor and I will wait with bated breath~
Professor, let's go shop for groceries!
Party~ Party~
As I watch the girls walk on the golden path lit by sunset, I find myself lost in thought.
All of the preparations have gone smoothly. I just hope this brings us closer to recovering the lost recording.
Will this finally be over then...?

sequence: "A world that falls apart at the slightest touch."
"The black bird calls out a name."
"That stench is but the hearth's smoke."
"Falling tears are but rain upon the street."
"Then may I still be caressed by the scent of flowers."

scripts.say: After days of never-ending preparation, the day of the performance came as scheduled.
Due to the Astral Tower's security policies, we could only enter the tower on the day of to set up the venue.
As such, we entered precisely at 6:00 AM as the doors opened to make the most of what little time we had.
Vicksburg, Harrison, and Rodgers beelined to the open-air terrace on the 170th floor to begin setting up the stage.
Bennington led the security robots to secure the building's entrances and key strategic points.
Richard and I documented the tower's internal structure, narrowing down the places where the recording could be hidden. Essex was doing the same, but separately.
Collett provided remote support throughout, managing encrypted communications, information analysis and synchronization, and real-time system hacking.

Our ultimate goals were to finish setting up the stage and scout the tower before the show began, and then to sweep any suspicious areas for the recording while everybody was distracted by the performance.
If all went smoothly, we'd be able to wait until the end of the show and leave together with Vicksburg's team. If not, the security robots would have to cover us while we fled via the escape route.
Awesome! It's finally the big day! I'm nervous, but I'm just as excited!
I hope it all works out...
We spent so much time preparing, we've memorized the plan from top to bottom... I'm sure it'll be okay!
Yeah! We'll be just fine!
Good luck~ I'll be watching over you from afar.
scripts.actorName: Cup Ramen Ambassador? [Morning Sun Over Azure Skies]

scripts.say: Take good care of that robot army! If you break them, I swear...
I'll pay double in compensation~
That's what I like to hear!
Don't forget to deploy those hacking bots ASAP. I can't wait to snoop around the tower and uncover its secrets...
Make sure you stay in touch while you're inside, too. My detective instincts tell me this won't be easy.
Right. Everybody, be careful. We have a lot of time until the show at 8:00 PM.
Yep! I have faith in your plan, Professor! We're definitely gonna get that recording back!
Everything is ready. Let's go!
In a certain room in the lower city, the curtains were drawn, and the air conditioning ran at max capacity.
The room's occupant sat in a computer chair shaped like a robo-cat, languidly typing away.
As the team and equipment entered the Astral Tower, the dozens of monitors on her walls lit up.
Heheh... My hacking robots are being deployed. Searching for a physical access node...
Found you... Beginning physical access.
Nice. Piece of cake.
Heheh, this is way easier than remote hacking...
Even the strongest fortress can't defend against an attack from within.
First, I'll find the blueprints of the building and save them from having to run around a bit.
Work proceeded smoothly. Before she knew it, she was singing to herself.
The black bird calls out a name♪
Soaring over rooftops, grazing dreams♪
In no time at all, Collett had found the building's blueprints, even including the locations of the server room and secret vault.
Server room, secret vault... Yeah, that's suspicious. Better sync my map with them and mark those as points of interest.
Next... the surveillance feeds...
If I can find the footage from the night of the theft, it should be easy to locate both the stolen item and the thief's identity.
That stench is but the hearth's smoke♪
Falling tears are but rain upon the street♪
Still singing, she broke through one firewall after another, saving countless tower secrets onto her local device.
It was as if she'd done this countless times before.
Wait... What's this feeling of déjà vu?
I've never hacked the tower before, so why do I feel like I've done all of this...
Hmm... I'll stop for now and send the data I've analyzed so far.
Richard and I had investigated every floor from the 1st to 66th. It was already lunch time by now.
I'm beat... Professor, let's take a little break.
The tower has 210 floors, so we're only a third of the way through. We can't rest yet...
But breaks are important! You haven't been sleeping well the past few days with all this work on the plan, have you?
Miss Detective and Miss Security Expert are doing their best to help out. I'm sure we'll make a breakthrough soon.
It's weird... They told us to keep in touch, but the connection has been going in and out.
Maybe there's interference inside the tower... At least we still have some connection. Besides, we planned for this level of disruption.
BEEP BEEP!
Speak of the devil, and all that! I just got a message. Looks like Miss Security Expert is hard at work.
The blueprints of the tower, huh? Goodness, there are so many pages.
Hmm... It looks like she narrowed it down to just 18 areas worth investigating?
That's great news.
She also mentioned that she's reviewing surveillance footage to narrow it down further.
Now we won't have to rush so much! Let's eat lunch already! Filling our bellies will make us better detectives~
Ahem... Maybe YOU aren't affected by hunger, Professor Detective, but I sure am!
For some reason, she seems proud about that.
Fair enough. Let's take a little break on this floor.
As Richard leads me toward the lounge area, I notice the slightest flash of blue in my periphery.
(A blue... moth?)
It's a single moth, with an oddly elegant aura and a mysterious blue glow.
It captivates me, filling me with the urge to hold it in my palm.
Richard...
What's the matter, Professor?
Despite how conspicuous it is, she's utterly oblivious to it.
(Am I the only person who can see it?)
The fog in my mind is ever present, but for some reason, I feel compelled to chase after it.
You go ahead and order, okay? I'm gonna run to the bathroom. Be right back.
Okay. Heheh~ I wonder what I should order!
As she leaves, I round a corner and hurry after the moth.
Meanwhile, in the safehouse with the curtains drawn...
After some inner conflict, the room's owner pushed aside her doubts and returned to her hacking.
It continued to proceed with concerning ease.
Surveillance system... hacked.
Filtering key areas... Adjusting date... Identifying motion changes...
Who's the thief, and where'd they hide the goods? It's time for me to see.
Error XIII's support allowed her to process vast quantities of surveillance data at blinding speed.
Before long, she found the answer she sought.
Found you... Thirty minutes after the theft, in the CEO's office.
Located on the 200th floor of Astral Tower...
She pressed the play button, allowing the frozen scene to move.
After nightfall, the empty CEO's office was the only source of light.
A gust of black wind blew through the window, filling the room with black fog.
After a while, the black fog dissipated, revealing a small data disk. Then came a fair white hand, followed by a single crimson eye.
Collett jumped to her feet, threw everything aside, jumped onto a robo-cat, and flew out the window on it.
Oh shit oh shit oh shit... Why was it HER? How could she be the one who stole the recording...
It was a trap all along... I gotta hide!
The robo-cat burst through a wall, sending Collett flying further ahead. However, instantly after, she realized that she was seated at her computer again – with the crimson eye fixed on her.
Hey.
The voice came from right behind her.
I'm sorry for prying into your secrets...
Without the courage to turn around or resist, she could only sit there as black fog crept up her shoulders. Her screens all turned black, and the room's AC halted.
There was an odd feeling, as if the walls were simultaneously closing in on her and expanding endlessly in all directions.
Is it... too late to surrender?
I wonder... Heheh~
When I open the bathroom door, a blue torrent rushes down from overhead.
Hello~ I knew it was you, Professor!
Long time no see! Mind if I just take a seat somewhere?
Good morning, Professor.
If you're already sighing so early in the morning, all your luck for the day's going to disappear, you know~
"Like moths to the flame, drawn here by lantern's glow."
What... did you do?
"O, moths that leap into purgatory, guide this traveler back to whence she came."
Urgh... my head... not again...
Hurry...
"Stop."
What about me? Am I not allowed to come along?
That was just a rhetorical question, you know. I just wanted an excuse to chat with you~♪
Huh? Richard?!!
...Huh?
...Richard? Where are you...?
I don't know! I somehow ended up in the middle of a dark alleyway!
...Alleyway?
I'M FLYIIING!
Flying over a weird city! Whoa... Hey, who the hell are you?
Shush! I've been asked to shelter you.
Hmmm... Doubtful! Why should I have to listen to YOU, huh?
"D, do as she says."
Huh?!
The fog in my mind cleared. I hadn't just remembered everything – I'd learned more things on top of that.
Helena... Thank you.
As I retrace the events so far, cold sweat rolls down my back.
It feels as if we were mere inches from plunging into the abyss.
If I hadn't remembered everything in time, there could have been unspeakable consequences.
That brain fog was all Richard's doing.
She made me forget everything, forced me to play along with this scenario she staged, made me help her look for this master recording...
I mean, that's just what she calls it. Who knows what it really is?
She's come this close to succeeding, too...
After being stagnant for days on end, my brain finally works at full speed.
Richard seems to be acting in two distinct forms – I might as well call them Richard White and Richard Black.
Richard Black is an incarnation of calamity. Her attempt to infiltrate test site beta was thwarted by the Antiochus.
Then, Richard White appeared before me, through the introduction of a girl who looked just like Zero.
If Zero anticipated that encounter, then it must follow that it was part of her plan.
Because of that, I thought of Richard White as harmless... or at least, not particularly dangerous.
I treated Richard White and Richard Black as separate entities, and I even began to believe that White was the real Bon Homme Richard.
But can she really be split into two distinct wholes so easily?
Is splitting into two beings somehow meaningful for her?
Perhaps... there was only one Bon Homme Richard all along.
Did Zero miscalculate? Is that why Helena chose this method to awaken me to the truth?
This... is bad.

sequence: I have to find a way out of this situation as soon as possible.

scripts.say: Bennington and the others must still be in the dark. They've forgotten their identities as shipgirls and have become lost in the rhythm of daily life.
I can try to awaken them... but we won't be enough to stand up against Richard.
Helena chose this roundabout way of awakening me because she can't interfere directly.
And Bristol META... We haven't met, but she's the one who sheltered Miss D and released that blue moth. She must be working with Helena.
I know... She must have a connection to the Essex from the Ashes. I'm sure Essex can track down Bristol and Miss D.
The message is sent in no time. It might not be enough to wake up someone sleeping, but no ace detective would miss a chance like this.
But this still isn't enough.
Collett is the only person who's free to act, since the rest of us are in the tower.
Maybe... I should have her get in contact with Saratoga and the others.
Damn it. Pamiat' Merkuria has been missing ever since the gas explosion...
But what if they're in on the plan? Maybe I shouldn't contact them carelessly... It's too much of a gamble.
I do still have options. Even if we're up against the CEO of Astral Tower, Collett is a master hacker. That should distract Richard, if nothing else.
When I send Collett a message, it confirms that it was sent – but I receive no response.
She was just inspecting the surveillance camera footage... Did she see something she shouldn't have?
I'm utterly lacking information. Maybe the best move is to escape this tower...
Cancel the concert and retreat immediately – forget the master recording. We'll make contact with Miss D somehow and use her whale to help us escape.
No, that won't work... That would be tantamount to a direct confrontation with Richard.
It looks like Miss D and the whale are my only hope...
For now, I'll have to keep Richard calm and buy time to stop her from finding that recording... Then, when I get an opportunity, I'll contact Miss D to make the escape.
Professor? You okay?
A gentle voice comes from behind me. Suddenly, her smile looks more like the devious grin of a predator admiring its prey.
(Richard? Why is she here?!)
Struggling to stay calm, I turn back to face her.
Is something wrong? I thought you were off ordering food.
I was worried about you... You were taking so long in the bathroom, you know?
And so... you followed me in?
Heheh~ I know, I know. It would be a disaster if someone saw a popular idol like me doing that.
Despite that, she comes closer.
Keep it a secret, 'kay?
The girl stands on her tiptoes and whispers into my ear, as if savoring the fear emanating from me.
(I'll just have to play along and stall for time.)
Right... Given your popularity, I do think you should be more careful about appearances.
Anyway, let's go eat. What kind of delicious food awaits us today?
Heheh, I'm sure you'll love it!
You'll just have to wait and see~
(Essex, Miss D, Bristol... You're my only hope now!)
The setup for the concert proceeded without issue.
Star's Dream was quite a fitting name for the terrace, as it would soon be host to a dazzling dream beneath the starry sky.
Thanks for all your hard work, everyone~ Take a break, okay? I'll take care of the little things myself!
No shot! The star needs to focus on her performance. WE'LL do the little things.
You need to be in perfect form for your show~ You've been looking forward to this for so long now.
Of course. Richard put a lot of hard work into teaching me. I promise, I'll deliver the best performance I can!
Not just for the sake of her lost recording, but for my dream... My dream of becoming an idol.
Give it your all! I'll be recording your solo concert from every angle imaginable!
Thank you very much! Now, I'd better get ready!
The newbie idol returned to her practice.
Rodgers and Harrison resumed their work, while Bennington went back into the corridor to check on building security.
Just then, she spotted a single moth emitting a faint blue glow.
What the?! Another anomaly here?
This is bad! If it interrupts the show...
Ah, wait! Don't run away! Let me get you on camera first!
She chased after the moth. When she rounded a corner, she found its owner awaiting her.
It's been a while, Bennington.
Hi there, um...
You may call me Legendary Investigator Bristol.
Nice to meet you... Bristol? Um, have we met before?
It's understandable that you don't remember me. There's a fog clouding your mind, obscuring your true self.
My... true self?
"Guided by a glimmer, revealed by lamp's shadow."
You are Bennington, the Essex-class aircraft carrier. Awaken from this false dream and face your truth!
Blue light collided with Bennington. She staggered violently, as if jolted awake.
I'm... You're... Huh? Where am I? And... what the heck have I been doing all this time?
Like a moth caught in a spider's web and injected with sweet venom, even if you awaken in your last moments, you're still trapped.
But you can survive this.
I remember now... When I first arrived in this city, we met... But I still don't understand you one bit!
Sorry, but I'm not one of your missing friends!
Let's just say I misjudged the situation.
Right now, every second counts. A dangerous ritual nears completion.
You all must work together to stop its fruition – however, the concert needs to proceed as planned.
Take these moths to snap them out of their trance.
Vicksburg... Harrison... John Rodgers!
Bennington receives the three moths and rushes back to stage.
Obey the moths if you want to live. Moths! Dance before the flames!
Once Bennington was gone, Bristol remained there.
After a while, all of her moths returned, having replaced their blue hues with a pure-white radiance and a rainbow aura.
Information on the Commander received... along with my reward.
Thanks for picking me as your temporary collaborator.
Per your instructions, Vicksburg's show will go on.
The other three will search for Saratoga, Soobrazitelny, and Pamiat' Merkuria. That is, if the latter is willing to be found.
Essex is searching for Miss D per the Commander's orders. She has a solid lead, so that ought to work out fine.
As for Bristol... Well, it seems it's time for me to say goodbye again.
Farewell, struggling moths.
If you remember your identities as shipgirls, then I hope you'll realize that running around isn't the only way to do recon anymore.
With that, the legendary investigator bowed slowly to her empty audience and vanished amidst a sudden burst of flames.
When the blue current struck, everybody's mind cleared, allowing them to remember everything.
They rode the current like a waterway, leaving the Astral Tower behind.
What in the world is going on here?
Astrarium had changed.
Different districts had been pieced together randomly like a jumbled puzzle.
Skyscrapers pierced waterways, and rocks sat atop trees. Towering buildings stood before ruins.
Black, viscous liquid like crude oil oozed from the seams, pooling into a dark ocean on the city streets.
Shapeless black shadows roamed in hordes, as if searching for prey.
Whoa... What happened to the city?!
Astrarium has always been a city of anomalies... Maybe this is it showing its true form.
I feel like I've been dreaming... I was just a normal girl – not myself.
We're shipgirls. How could we have forgotten something so important?
And Richard is the mastermind... Worse, she has the power to destroy the whole city.
We have to stop her... Let's complete this mission and go home safe!
That's exactly what I plan to do! As for the three vendors, which one should we search for first?
Let's start with the genius mechanic Soobrazitelny. She's the one who loaned us those robots, after all!
What better backup than a whole robot army?
KABOOOOM!
Hahahaaah! Weak! Too weak! Tremble before my legion of machines!
Amidst the chaotic ocean, there was one small island governed by order.
No matter how the grotesque mob tried to attack, they all faced the same destruction.
So Astrarium has finally come to this...
I guess it was meant to be, in the end.
Just can't believe that even I fell for the trap called comfort...
Scary, indeed.
KABOOOOM!
The genius mechanic looked upward and spotted three figures approaching from afar.
They were clearly approaching her without hesitation.
This is Bennington, Essex-class aircraft carrier, speaking on the public channel!
Hello? Genius Mechanic Soobrazitelny, can you hear me? The city's in real danger, and it needs your help!
Hmm... The cloaking should have collapsed along with the city.
What fascinating girls.
BEEP BEEP!
Soobrazitelny speaking. It's good to see normal people amidst all the chaos!
I'm in. If you've got a plan, then lead the way!
Quiet prevailed here under the moonlight.
The chaos of the city had yet to reach this area, leaving this shop peaceful for now.
The charming shopkeeper, though armed to the teeth, sat quietly at the entrance and gazed up at the moon.
Today, a repeat of yesterday...
And tomorrow the same.
If all is a dream...
KABOOOOM!
The sounds of battle drew nearer.
I am Saratoga.
Saratoga of the Council's First Task Force. The one you've been waiting for.
So it's time for me to join the fight.
Goodbye, Richard...
She locked a small padlock on the door.
The storefront was left deserted as combat intensified in the distance.
Thanks to the guidance of carrier-based aircraft, the party was able to press forward through the jumbled space.
Eventually, they reached the place where PM Plaza should be.
Yet the lot remained vacant, with the shopkeeper nowhere to be found.
Pamiat' Merkuria still hasn't been seen since that day...
If we can't find her, then that's that. We need to get back to Astral Tower.
Who knows how bad things are back there?!
The jumbled space began to reconfigure itself anew.
Either by design or by pure coincidence, a direct passage to the Astral Tower appeared.
Huh? Did Pamiat' make this passage for us?!
Thanks, Pamiat' Merkuria!
There was no response.
However, one gaze watched silently from afar as the fleet vanished into the distance.
Lights burst to life, and music began to play. The newbie idol took a deep breath and stepped forth onto the stage.
I may have awakened from that dream, but there's still something I must do.
Richard... I'm going to deliver a flawless performance, for the sake of stopping your plans.

scripts.say: A pleasant song rang out from the starlit stage.
Vicksburg's concert had finally begun.
Meanwhile...
Check this out, Professor! The CEO's office has a view of the concert stage AND the rest of the city!
It is a nice view... You really can see everything in the city from here.
Surrounded by an outer ring, the city almost looks like a giant magic circle. From this vantage point, three letter-shaped skyscrapers stand out.
The ruler of this city had never even tried to hide her identity. Anybody who visited this office could see it as clear as day.
Professor Detective, I've had fun these past few days.
So much fun...
But every vacation has to come to an end eventually. We still have our work to do as detective and assistant.
Have you found the recording, Professor?
She casually sits down on a couch, closes her eyes, and asks me one simple question.
The "stolen" disk sits plainly on the low table in front of her.
It's just sitting out in the open, huh?
Yep. What a careless thief. They didn't even try to hide it!
She opens her eyes. Despite a flicker of hesitation, she quickly returns to her usual smile.
Well, Professor. Hand over the disk.
Do that, and your mission is complete.
She raises a hand, but instead of reaching directly for the disk, she points at me.
I knew it... Something will happen specifically if I hand it to you, right?
It's a new song. Why don't we listen to it together first?
My best course of action is to stall for time.
The opening number she's singing right now is my new song.
You heard it a bunch of times during practice.
The title they know is just a fake one, that's all.
Its real name is Pandora's Wish.
You taught somebody else your new song?!
For some reason, that's the first thought that comes to mind.
I lost my stage and my audience a long time ago... but she's different.
You're saying it's time to put an end to this.
Heheh~ Maybe not yet. Let's wait a little.
Richard smiles sweetly.
We put so much work into this concert. It'd be a waste if we didn't enjoy it, right?
You still haven't answered the question that will put this case to rest: the name of the culprit.
For now, at least... we're still professor and assistant, okay? So let's watch together.
...Okay.
I sit across from Richard and slip the disk into my pocket.
Some time later, the concert was drawing to a close.
After remaining silent for the entirety of the show, Bon Homme Richard finally spoke.
Professor, I was waiting until after the concert to tell you the truth...
But what are you waiting for?
A potential turning point.
You mean the fan club running around the city?
So you really don't know.
Know... what?
You're acting under multiple restrictions. That's why you can't freely wield your power.
The reason Richard Black hasn't shown herself even once is because of that limitation. Isn't that right?
Heheh.
She does not answer.
Have you never considered that she and I might be two separate entities?
You tell me. Are you?
Richard still doesn't give a firm answer, instead looking at me wistfully.
Despite knowing it's an act, I decide to voice my initial theory.
To be honest... when you first appeared in that classroom, I really did think you were a separate entity.
Because your presence there seemed to be a guarantee of your harmlessness by the Antiochus.
But... in the end, you're just Richard.
You deceived both the Antiochus and Observer Zero.
That's nothing worth writing home about. Zero was never all that smart after all~
..."Zero"?
Yup. In the end, it was all a part of HER plan.
Wait... Zero... isn't Observer Zero?
What's the difference between you and the Commander?
I am the Commander.
Then she's Observer Zero.
That's hardly an answer...
Your fault for trying to waste time with idle conversation.
What kind of professor tries to make the student provide all the answers?
Silence rules again as the concert reaches its final song.
Blue Spirit.
She was practicing this song when we first met... Look how far she's come.
Time flies, huh? The concert is about to end...
You didn't realize who I really am until just recently, right? How'd you figure it out?
How did YOU realize that I knew?
Aha! Another question answered with a question. You really wanna be that cagey with me?
Well, I don't mind answering this one.
After you went to the bathroom, you started looking at me differently.
I could tell that you were trying to hide it, but I'm kind of a professional.
So there are things you don't know, too.
I had to make a lot of sacrifices to trick Zero.
That includes the restrictions you deduced... and a lot more.
But once you hand me that master recording, all of this will be over.
What happens after that?
If you wanted to be with me forever after that, I would certainly welcome that~
After the curtain call, the stage lights dimmed. The concert was over.
Professor Detective, your assistant has a question for you. Who was the culprit?
It was you, Bon Homme Richard. You staged the theft of the master recording and set up all of this.
Bingo! You are so smart.
I'll be taking that recording now.
If you can't pick it up yourself, then I see no reason to hand it over.
Great deduction, but you've overlooked something.
If you've got your memories back, then you should remember what happened under the tree in the garden.
Under the tree... in the garden?
Hand over the disk.
(Damn... I forgot!)
(I can't... control myself!)
Defying my will, my hand reaches into my pocket and slowly pulls out the disk. Then, it extends toward the smiling girl.
Just as Richard's fingers are about to touch the disk, there's a deafening crash as her window shatters.
WAIT, WAIT, WAAAIT!
Assistant! Assistant, I'm here to help!
Tch...
As soon as Miss D appears, Richard vanishes. The world outside undergoes a drastic transformation.

sequence: "A world that falls apart at the slightest touch."

scripts.say: The dream beneath the neon lights has been shattered.
When Miss D smashed through the window, she also tore away the false illusions shrouding the Astral Tower, thus revealing the true form of Astrarium.
Dilapidated and desolate...
The anomalies here were never truly anomalies – they were the city's true essence seeping through.
Its prosperity was only an illusion. This is the true Astrarium.
The magic circle beneath the city lights up and ascends into the sky.
Everybody doing battle within the city rises up to the height of the CEO's office along with it.
Miss D clings to me like a koala. Bennington, Vicksburg, Harrison, and John Rodgers are here as well.
Along with the META Soobrazitelny, Saratoga, and Essex.
However, Pamiat', Bristol, and Collett are nowhere to be found.
You were all META after all... You hid the truth well.
It's been a while, Commander. Last we met was in the mountains of Anchorage.
Do you remember all of that? If so... then who are you, really?
Could she really be the same Essex who was working with the Ashes?
This is the first time I've seen her awake ever since she fell into a coma during the "perfect future" incident.
Well, excluding all the times I'd seen her as a detective over these past days, of course.
My mind is still a mess...
But I think I may have really survived that.
Just as I don't know how I came to this city, I also don't know what happened after I was swallowed up by the vector zone...
I see... Well, what matters is that you're okay. We can figure the rest out with time.
What about Bristol and Collett?
I think the legendary investigator has gone into hiding. As for Collett, well... I'm sorry to say.
I understand. Do you know anything about the other two vendors?
They both happen to have their own issues at hand.
One claims to be a member of the Council's First Task Force, but she recognizes neither Enterprise nor me.
The other one says she's from an organization called "Dawn", but I've never heard of such a thing...
I don't think now is the time to dwell on that.
Besides, you won't get much thinking done in this chaos.
Essex looks up at Richard, who floats in the distance.
I need more time to get ready, so you all just make yourselves at home!
She smiles and waves.
Richard is under some kind of restriction right now – it seems she won't be able to use her true power unless somebody actively gives her the master recording.
Where is it now?
I have it. But... she has the power to control people with her words.
Best we take her down sooner rather than later.
Agreed.
One more thing: can you get in contact with Enterprise?
If we could just get her help...
I'm sorry, but it isn't possible.
I thought you might say that.
Having chosen to fight Richard now, each ship launches her own attack on the enemy.
KABOOOOM!
Boom! You're surrounded, Richard!
Please just surrender, Richard!
The army of dark shadows is as frail as ever, each going down in one blow.
Her inability to summon stronger enemies is further proof of her current weakness.
You really... had us fooled for so long!
*sniffle*... You've gone too far!
See what you've done, Richard?
Heheh... Sorry. I have my reasons.
But if you just hand over the disk, I promise everybody will get to go home safe. How about it?
Hahah! Why would we do that when we have the upper hand?
True. I can't get my power back without that disk, and that's why you're trying to take me down now. Isn't that right, Professor?
But take a closer look. Do I look like I've taken any damage?
Despite having taken constant attacks since the start of the battle, Richard is unwounded. Her clothes and hair remain unruffled.
She just watches the battle rage on with a smile, as if quietly waiting for something.
What are you waiting for?
For my restrictions to wear off, of course~
Come on. You didn't think I'd make it so I couldn't free myself, did you?
I know that. That's why...
You're too weak~ Sorry, Professor, but you lose!
Heeheeheeheehee!
Allow me to reintroduce myself! I am Bon Homme Richard, and you're totally surrounded – by me!
Shit...
The magic circle shatters, and all of us begin to fall.
AAAAAAH!

sequence: Were we simply too late because our firepower was lacking?

scripts.say: As Miss D stops me from falling, I can finally get a look at what's going on around me.
Kometa's advance is accelerating...
Soobrazitelny attempts to stabilize her position in the air using her mech.
You're too late, genius mechanic!
Bang!
Richard makes a finger gun with her right hand. Suddenly, Soobrazitelny and her robotic army all turn to ash.
What?!
Richard, you...
Saratoga releases control of her aircraft and gazes silently at the approaching enemy.
Good night, Sara.
Bang!
She, too, turns to ash along with her planes.
I have to do something about this...
Snooping from the sidelines isn't very fair, legendary investigator!
Black wind tears through glowing moths, outlining a hidden figure.
H-hahaha... Guess you found me.
Nobody likes uninvited guests, you know.
Then I'd better take my leave–
Bang!
Bristol transforms into an eclipse of moths, but they're instantly turned into ash. Only a few of them manage to escape into the distant fog.
You're next, Miss Detective.
Richard appears like a phantom next to Essex.
What are you trying to do here, really?
Is this my dream? Or...
Bang!
Not gonna happen!
Two dark forces collide. After a struggle, Essex is slammed into the ruins below.
Heheh, and next up...
Richard turns her attention to Bennington's fleet.
They can't withstand her attacks!
Oh... That's it!
Understood. D, help us approach the target. We'll proceed from there.
How many times do I have to say it?! No whale, no dice! Not happening!
Fine. I'll do it for you, then.
Resource diversion, data transfer mode.
Hwuh? What's going on? Whoa, whoa, whoa!
Miss D! Back in the Martyrium, you said you couldn't get close to Rodney without your whale.
Now that you have the whale, can you use it to save everybody?!
Hmm... I'll try it!
But keep Richard away, or else she'll catch me!
So I have to distract her?
(There's no other way, now that she has her power again.)
(Hopefully this will still be enough to entice her...)
Throw this into the air as hard as you can!
Miss D throws the master recording disk up into the sky. As expected, Richard chases after it.
Now! Let's save them!
The rescue went smoothly.
After catching the disk, Richard stopped in mid-air for a while, seemingly inspecting it.
Meanwhile, after being subjected to five teleports courtesy of Miss D, we had united with Bennington's fleet on the seas outside of Astrarium.
What? You used the master recording as bait?!
All for our sake... I'm sorry that we turned out to be such a burden.
Not at all. Richard already had her power back anyway.
None of this is anybody's fault. Our enemy is just too strong... She's not somebody you should have to fight.
US? No, she's not somebody YOU should have to fight, either!
We're shipgirls. You're not!
But my assistant is a member of the Council. That makes my assistant strong!
Council...?
If we're just going to make small talk all day, then I'm leaving.
Hold on. Do you have a way to get out of this place?
Well, no. But if I die, I die.
Good grief... All of you Ashes say that.
(Let's calm down and figure this out.)
(Richard appeared in one of Zero's experiments.)
(Things are spiraling out of control now, but there's no way that she came unprepared.)
(But what CAN she do? What is she willing to do?)
(The only thing in Astrarium connected to the Antiochus would be Miss D herself.)
(Helena recognized Miss D's importance – that's why she had Bristol guard her.)
(Richard is clearly wary of her, too... Why?)
(Is it the whale? Or Death's Scythe itself?)
(Bristol's moths didn't all get eliminated. A few of them managed to drift off into the fog.)
(The fog shrouding Astrarium... Based on the angle of that overpass, it must lead out of the city.)
(Could Death's Scythe... cut through the fog?)
Given the situation, this might just be our only chance of escape.
Heheh~ Recording confirmed. Did you get enough rest, Professor?
Let's get back to our slaughter♪
Didn't you say you'd send us all home safe once you had the disk?
As I bought time, I tried to think of the password needed to activate Death's Scythe.
(Knowing Dr. Aoste, there must be a password. What could it be?)
I've changed my mind. It's not like you have any power over the situation, anyway.
